name: code-graph
description: The Claude Code skills for the code-graph MCP server: codebase orientation, call-chain tracing, dead-code and fan-out analysis, and a tool/Cypher reference. Versioned with the server that serves them.

plugins.name: code-graph-skills
plugins.description: Four skills for querying a code-graph knowledge graph: code-graph-exploring (structure and orientation), code-graph-tracing (call chains, cross-service edges, git-diff blast radius), code-graph-quality (dead code, fan-out, refactor candidates), and code-graph-reference (tool surface, Cypher subset, edge types, pitfalls).
